title: Void Drifter
tagline: Fly, loot, bank it or lose it. Rebuild your station one run at a time.
summary: A 2D top-down sci-fi rogue-lite in the browser. You pilot customizable ships through hostile systems, and everything you carry is lost if you die.
description:
Void Drifter is a 2D top-down sci-fi rogue-lite played in the browser. You are a digitized human consciousness piloting customizable ships through hostile, procedurally generated systems, scavenging alien tech to finish building your stranded home station.

The design leans toward an **extraction looter**. The galaxy is permanent and gets charted run by run, and what is at risk each run is the clone, its ship and everything it carries. Every anomaly and every gate is a choice: push deeper for better loot, or recall and bank what you have.

Combat is top-down and tactical: positioning, range, cover, target priority and module timing matter more than twitch aiming. The enemies are the Gardeners, an alien industrial AI that treats the sector as its farm.

The game is built with Phaser 3 and TypeScript, and it is still in development. A VR version of the same game exists as a separate project.
features: Customizable hulls, slots, weapons and modules, with trade-offs rather than strict upgrades
Push-your-luck runs: everything you carry is lost on death unless you recall first
A permanent galaxy that you chart across runs
A Hangar where banked materials and blueprints are spent between runs
The Gardeners, alien harvesting machines, as the main enemy
